'''Grk'kkrs'arr''' was a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] residing on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and a member of [[Sharad Hett]]'s clan. Joining in the hunt for a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] during [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett's]] rite of passage, Grk'kkrs'arr was the first to draw blood from the dragon using his [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaderffii]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] had been fighting the beast, before the Tuskens joined the fight, and after the wound was inflicted by Grk'kkrs'arr, the dragon swallowed the Tusken.
